sources.snippet: Aɣbalu — Kabyle for the source, the fountainhead. Natural language processing for Kabyle (Taqbaylit, ISO 639-3 kab, BCP-47 kab-Latn), a Northern Berber language of Kabylia, Algeria with roughly 5-7 million speakers. The corpus is the primary artifact; the models are built on top of it.
